definitions.explanation: A cat with patches of three colors: white, black and orange-brown. Almost all calico cats are female, since the coloring depends on the X chromosome.

examples.japanese: ⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧{三毛猫|みけねこ}。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三毛猫|みけねこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十歳|じゅっさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Our calico cat is turning ten.

examples.japanese: {三毛猫|みけねこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧オス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しく→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧、⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Male calico cats are very rare and are said to bring good luck.

notes:
{三|み} (three) + ⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧ (fur) + ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧. Often shortened to {三毛|みけ}, which is also a common name for a calico cat.
